source: V = vocabulary size; T = sequence length; d_model = Transformer hidden/token-embedding width; d = a generic representation width; d_e = the final text-embedding dimension when it differs from the model hidden width. Sections define any additional local symbols where they appear.
zh: V = 词汇量； T = 序列长度； d_model = Transformer 隐藏/令牌嵌入宽度； d = 通用表示宽度； d_e = 最终文本嵌入尺寸（当它与模型隐藏宽度不同时）。节定义了它们出现的任何附加局部符号。
